scripts.rc-final: npx -y cross-env RC_E2E=1 npm run rc-smoke
scripts.prisma:linux:validate: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/app" -w /app node:20-bullseye bash -lc "export DATABASE_URL=\"${DATABASE_URL:-$(grep DATABASE_URL .env | cut -d= -f2-)}\" && npm install && npx prisma validate"
scripts.prisma:linux:generate: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/app" -w /app node:20-bullseye bash -lc "export DATABASE_URL=\"${DATABASE_URL:-$(grep DATABASE_URL .env | cut -d= -f2-)}\" && npm install && npx prisma generate"
scripts.prisma:linux:migrate: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/app" -w /app node:20-bullseye bash -lc "export DATABASE_URL=\"${DATABASE_URL:-$(grep DATABASE_URL .env | cut -d= -f2-)}\" && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev"
scripts.prisma:linux:push: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/app" -w /app node:20-bullseye bash -lc "export DATABASE_URL=\"${DATABASE_URL:-$(grep DATABASE_URL .env | cut -d= -f2-)}\" && npm install && npx prisma db push"
scripts.prisma:linux:smoke: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/app" -w /app node:20-bullseye bash -lc "export DATABASE_URL=\"${DATABASE_URL:-$(grep DATABASE_URL .env | cut -d= -f2-)}\" && npm install && npx tsx scripts/db-smoke-test.ts"
